## Deferrals read
Read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` first. Dispositions:
- **DF-S2.10-2 — DONE.** The readers-withholding half of
  AC-R-2.11.1-16 is landed and executable: `withhold_uncovered` gates
  `emit_result` (`json`) and `render_event` (`jsonl`); the LT battery
  over the gate produces no secret bytes. (ADR-0274 D2.)
- **DF-S1.26-2 — OPEN, progress note.** The attended lifecycle verbs
  landed; the parked-detach interim (`ok` + `detached:"parked"`) is
  retained — a new `ExitClass` member would widen the closed sum
  without a §2.5 row (ADR-0274 D9).
- **DF-S1.25-2 — OPEN (unchanged).** Durable leaf checkpoint /
  cross-process resume remains deferred; `run resume` surfaces
  `Refused{resume_checkpoint_unavailable}` verbatim.
- **DF-S1.12-6 — OPEN (unchanged).** Reader-set flow through
  containment stays the later C2/containment ticket; the CLI gate uses
  the invocation's `{principal}` reader set only (ADR-0274 D2).
- No other prior deferral's owner row names this ticket.

## Deviations / owned decisions
- `--at-seq` retained as an alias for the ticketed `--until-seq`
  (ADR-0274 D1).
- Withholding tombstone replaces only `content`/`payload`; metadata
  stays (ADR-0274 D2).
- `ModelSnapshotRecord` identity scheme + probe domain spellings
  (ADR-0274 D3/D4); `observe()` precedence + the gateway's
  report-never-decide boundary (D5).
- DF-S1.26-2 left OPEN — detach surface needs a §2.5 row, not a
  unilateral `ExitClass` member (ADR-0274 D9).
